label: VRM forecast
info:
Reads the hourly VRM forecast (Dynamic ESS stats) every 15 minutes and writes it to Home Assistant: sensor.vrm_forecast_hours (attribute 'hours'). Used by VRM Style Cards.

After import: open the VRM node and select your VRM API config node and installation (site id); open the sensor node and select your Home Assistant server.

name: Hourly forecast + base load
